tickets.name: Early Offense
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for Pistons at Heat, because the first minute is where the money is! The jump ball goes Adebayo against Collins, and Adebayo has the springs tonight! That hands the Heat the first possession, and that's half the battle! The Heat's first set runs through Thompson, and he's got the green light shining bright! And Mitchell is the backup plan on that possession, a fine backup plan at that!
